name: Tools — BYOM support matrix (rollup)
summary: Single-place rollup of every agent tool tracked in this repo and whether it works when the Prompt Agent's orchestrator model uses the BYOM {conn}/{deployment} prefix.
description: Tools attached to a Prompt Agent whose model is BYOM-prefixed do not always work — Foundry maintains an internal allow-list. This card enumerates every tool the repo tracks, its current status, and links to the per-tool card with the runnable probe. Update this rollup whenever a per-tool card's `support_status` changes.
notes:
Snapshot of `features/tool-*/feature.json` on 2026-07-20. Each row links to the per-tool card that carries the actual probe, error text, and evidence.

**Officially supported per Microsoft docs** (`ai-gateway#supported-configurations`): Code Interpreter, Functions, File Search, OpenAPI, Foundry IQ, SharePoint Grounding, Fabric Data Agent, MCP, Browser Automation (Computer Use).

### ✅ Works with BYOM (verified in this repo)

| Tool | Card | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Code Interpreter | [`tool-code-interpreter`](#tool-code-interpreter) | 1P sandbox, no connection needed. |
| Functions (custom) | [`tool-functions`](#tool-functions) | Caller-defined function-calling schema. |
| File Search | [`tool-file-search`](#tool-file-search) | Requires a pre-populated `FILE_SEARCH_VECTOR_STORE_ID`. |
| OpenAPI | [`tool-openapi`](#tool-openapi) | Any RESTful spec (`OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH`). |
| Computer Use (Browser Automation) | [`tool-computer-use`](#tool-computer-use) | `COMPUTER_USE_ENVIRONMENT=browser`. |
| Azure AI Search | [`tool-azure-ai-search`](#tool-azure-ai-search) | Needs `AZURE_AI_SEARCH_CONNECTION_ID` + index. |
| SharePoint Grounding (OBO) | [`tool-sharepoint`](#tool-sharepoint) | Needs `SHAREPOINT_CONNECTION_ID`. |
| Fabric Data Agent (OBO) | [`tool-fabric-data-agent`](#tool-fabric-data-agent) | Needs `FABRIC_CONNECTION_ID`. |
| Foundry IQ (1P MCP) | [`tool-foundry-iq`](#tool-foundry-iq) | `FOUNDRY_IQ_MCP_URL`. |
| Web IQ (1P MCP) | [`tool-web-iq`](#tool-web-iq) | `WEB_IQ_MCP_URL` + `WEB_IQ_API_KEY`. |
| OpenAI built-in web search (GA name) | [`tool-web-search-openai`](#tool-web-search-openai) | Only `{"type": "web_search"}`; preview/date-versioned names rejected. |

### ❌ Not supported with BYOM (verbatim error captured)

| Tool | Card | Foundry error |
|---|---|---|
| Web search — Bing grounding | [`tool-web-search`](#tool-web-search) | `"not supported with BYO model: bing_grounding"` |
| Web search — OpenAI `web_search_preview*` variants | [`tool-web-search-openai`](#tool-web-search-openai) | `"not supported with BYO model: web_search_preview[_YYYY_MM_DD]"` |
| Agent-to-Agent (A2A) as a tool | [`tool-a2a`](#tool-a2a) | See card for details on the caller-side flow gap. |
| Fabric IQ (1P MCP) | [`tool-fabric-iq`](#tool-fabric-iq) | Absent from docs' supported-tools list; MCP variant not exposed. |

### ❓ Not confirmed (probe blocked by missing env vars or Foundry preview state)

| Tool | Card | Blocker |
|---|---|---|
| Logic Apps | [`tool-logic-apps`](#tool-logic-apps) | Needs `LOGIC_APP_RESOURCE_ID` + `LOGIC_APP_WORKFLOW_NAME`. |
| MCP with agent Entra identity | [`tool-mcp-entra-agent`](#tool-mcp-entra-agent) | Needs `MCP_SERVER_URL_AGENT_IDENTITY`. |
| MCP with project Entra identity | [`tool-mcp-entra-project`](#tool-mcp-entra-project) | Uses `MCP_SERVER_URL`; verified once but not currently rerun. |
| MCP with OAuth passthrough | [`tool-mcp-oauth-passthrough`](#tool-mcp-oauth-passthrough) | Needs `MCP_SERVER_URL_OAUTH`. |
| Memory | [`tool-memory`](#tool-memory) | Status-only — no test yet, needs `MEMORY_STORE_ID`. |
| Work IQ (1P MCP) | [`tool-work-iq`](#tool-work-iq) | Needs `WORK_IQ_MCP_URL`. |

When adding or flipping a per-tool card's `support_status`, update the matching row here. This card intentionally has no `test_file`; the source of truth is each per-tool card.
